description: Independent universal surface coverage using cyan control material and the same SDK scene, binding strengths, pixel thresholds and 98 percent coverage requirement.
expected_video: Authored materials remain visible under the weak cyan control; the strong cyan control measures the complete silhouette.
logs:
With the render-context list pinned to [universal], 100.0% of the asset's 152330 pixel silhouette is shaded by materials the asset authored, and 0 pixel(s) came back as the control. The two frames are the same scene under the same pin, differing only in the strength of one binding, so that share is the asset's own bindings and nothing else. The asset has a surface on: universal.

Coverage on its own does not establish that those materials evaluated. A shader that fails to resolve still wins over the weak control and counts as covered, which is what the MaterialX validation log reports separately.
